blocks.text: How fast Langley homes are selling right now

parts.t: "Fast" depends on what you are selling. In October 2026, Langley townhouses were the strongest segment in the Fraser Valley board's figures: 76 sold against 260 for sale, a 29.2% sales-to-active ratio. Detached houses and condos moved more slowly, at 13.6% and 14.9%. Across the Fraser Valley, homes took 50 days to sell on average for detached, 37 for townhouses and 44 for condos.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: I prepare a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the home evaluation form on this site.

faq.q: Should I buy first or sell first in Langley?
faq.a: In a market where homes take weeks to sell, selling first (or making your purchase subject to sale) protects you from carrying two homes. If your home type is selling quickly, as Langley townhouses were in October 2026, buying first carries less risk. We can look at your numbers together.

faq.q: What does it cost to sell, and when do I become your client?
faq.a: We go over commission, marketing costs and your other selling costs in the first conversation, before you sign anything. Under BC rules a REALTOR® must explain fees and tell you at the start whether they can represent you as a client.
